title: Looking after my teeth
examples: What should I eat to keep my teeth strong?
How often should I brush my teeth?

explain.say: Today you will learn how to look after your teeth.
Your first teeth are called milk teeth.
Most children have twenty milk teeth. They help you chew your food.
Brush your teeth twice a day, in the morning and before bed.
Use a small amount of toothpaste, about the size of a pea. Brush in small circles.
Fruits, vegetables, milk and water are everyday foods. They are kind to your teeth. Sweet things are sometimes foods.

draw.text: Everyday foods are kind to teeth

faq.q: How many milk teeth do children have?
faq.a: Children usually have twenty milk teeth in their mouth. These are the first teeth that grow in.
asks: How many baby teeth are there?
What is the number of milk teeth?

faq.q: How often should I brush my teeth?
faq.a: You should brush your teeth twice every day. Brushing in the morning and before bed is very important.
asks: When should I brush my teeth?
Do I brush my teeth once a day?

faq.q: What kind of food is best for my teeth?
faq.a: Everyday foods like fruit, vegetables, milk and cheese are kind to your teeth. Sweet foods and drinks are sometimes foods.

faq.q: Do I need to brush my teeth if I only eat soft food?
faq.a: Yes, you still need to brush your teeth every day. Brushing cleans away food bits and germs.
asks: Is brushing important even if I eat little?
Do I still brush if I eat soup?

faq.q: When do milk teeth fall out?
faq.a: Milk teeth will eventually fall out to make room for your permanent teeth. This is a normal part of growing up.
asks: Do I lose my milk teeth?
When do my baby teeth change?

facts: Milk teeth are the first set of teeth a person has.
Brushing twice daily helps keep teeth clean.
Everyday foods like fruit, vegetables and milk help keep teeth strong.
Milk teeth eventually fall out to make way for adult teeth.

quiz.say: How many times a day should you brush your teeth?
quiz.why: Brush in the morning and before bed. That is two times.

wrong.1: Once is a good start, and a second brush at night cleans away the day's food.
wrong.2: Ten is more than you need, and two good brushes are enough.

quiz.say: Which snack is an everyday food for your teeth?
quiz.why: Crunchy vegetables like carrots are kind to your teeth.

wrong.0: Sugar sticks to teeth, so sweets are a sometimes food.
wrong.2: Fizzy drinks have lots of sugar, so they are a sometimes drink.

quiz.say: How much toothpaste should you use?
quiz.why: A small amount, the size of a pea, is right for children.

wrong.0: A brush full is more than you need, and a small amount works well.
wrong.1: Toothpaste helps keep teeth strong, so use a little.
